scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && uv --directory backend sync --locked
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
